plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Music, General A.A. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7934/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Total Units 60 = 15+15+16+14 (semester sums verified). MUIVI 410 Applied Music (1 unit) is genuinely repeated in all 4 semesters per the map's explicit footnote ('Students must enroll in MUIVI 410 each semester for 4 semesters'); auditions take place the first week of classes to enter MUIVI 410. allow_repeated_courses is true and documented here. MUFHL 405 lists MUFHL 402 & 403 as prerequisites; those courses are not sequenced in the map (the map sequences the combined MUFHL 400 instead) and are carried under external_prereqs. Semester 3 includes one 3-unit course meeting both CRC Local GE Area L4 (Social & Behavioral Sciences) and Area VI (Ethnic/Multicultural Studies), per the map. List A (large ensembles, minimum 8 units): MUP 310/311/320/321/330/331/353/357/360/424 — 2 units sequenced in each semester (8 total); a different course per slot. Advisories are recommendations only, recorded in choice_notes, never as prereqs.
